description: Waterinfo is a website of the Flemish government that informs the public about floods and drought and brings together all measurements and forecasts, so that measures can be taken to keep water damage to a minimum. The home page shows the current status for flooding, tide, precipitation and drought, with news such as low-water bulletins for the waterways. The Measurements section lets users select parameters to view, download or compare measurement series, with filters and export, and states that the data are also available through web services. Further pages cover the status of retention basins, drone video, reports, and the flood report used for the information duty in real estate sales. Coverage is Flanders in Belgium. Access is free online, with an optional account sign-on. Caveats: the licence was not stated on the pages read, and the web services guide is a PDF whose text could not be extracted. Simulation uses: flood and drought early warning, forcing and calibration of river and sewer models, and hazard exposure for assets. Related records: Rijkswaterstaat Waterinfo web services (data-rijkswaterstaat-waterinfo-waterwebservices) and PEGELONLINE (data-pegelonline-federal-waterways-water-levels).
